# Asset kinds GraphCode reads and writes

*Generated by `tools/gen_kinds.py` from `Plugins/GraphCode/Resources/mcp-bridge/graphcode-capabilities.json`,
the capability registry shipped in this release (registry version `1`). Do not edit by hand.*

A **kind** is a type of Unreal asset that has one `.gc` text document. A **block** is one section of
that document (`properties`, `graph`, `components`...). `omits:` names what the document does **not**
carry, so a reviewer knows exactly where the text stops. Products marked *program-first* author
assets from their own recipe files (`.gcshape`, `.gcmove`, `.gcrig`, `.gcgroom`, `.gcgarment`, `.gchuman`,
`.gcw`) or drive the running game (`gc_play`), and their results appear here as the kinds they build.

| | Count |
|---|---|
| Products in the registry | 10 |
| Asset kinds | 60 |
| Kinds a document can create from nothing | 48 |
| Blocks | 259 (204 read + write, 15 write when available, 40 read only) |
| Kinds that omit nothing (`omits: none`) | 16 |
| Distinct omission tokens | 74 |
